end.summary:
Practised turning observations into testable questions.
Neel formed testable questions about falling utensils and container heat retention.
They identified that increased screen brightness can use more battery energy.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; one of two attempts was unaided correct.
No misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised changing observations into questions that can be checked by testing. They were unsure about the reason in one example; it was clarified later when they gave the energy explanation. At home, ask Neel to turn one everyday observation into a question and name one thing that could be changed or measured.
